bca_designation_changed = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_city
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_city }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_mining
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_mining }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_farming
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_farming }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_generator
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_generator }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_hive
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_hive }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_nexus
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_nexus }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_industrial
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_industrial }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_foundry
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_foundry }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_factory
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_factory }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_bureau
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_bureau }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_bureau_spiritualist
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_bureau_spiritualist }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_bureau_hive
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_bureau_hive }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_bureau_machine
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_bureau_machine }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_trade_machine
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_trade_machine }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_research
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_research }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_fortress
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_fortress }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_capital
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_capital }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_capital_foundry
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_capital_foundry }
        }
        AND = {
            has_designation = col_capital_factory
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_capital_factory }
        }

        num_zones = { type = zone_unity_spiritualist value > 0 }
        num_zones = { type = zone_resort_spiritual_retreat value > 0 }
        num_zones = { type = zone_unity_spiritualist_arcology value > 0 }
        num_zones = { type = zone_unity_spiritualist_ring_world value > 0 }
        num_zones = { type = zone_unity_spiritualist_nexus value > 0 }
    }
}

bca_has_district_d1 = {
    OR = {
        has_district = district_resort_1
        has_district = district_hive_1
        has_district = district_nexus_1
        has_district = district_arcology_urban_1
        has_district = district_rw_urban_1
        has_district = district_generator
        has_district = district_geothermal
        has_district = district_hab_energy
        has_district = district_photosynthesis_fields
        has_district = district_ark_generator
    }
}


bca_has_district_d2 = {
    OR = {
        has_district = district_resort_2
        has_district = district_hive_2
        has_district = district_nexus_2
        has_district = district_arcology_urban_2
        has_district = district_rw_urban_2
        has_district = district_mining
        has_district = district_melting
        has_district = district_hab_mining
        has_district = district_hollow_mountains
        has_district = district_ark_forever_cruise
        has_district = district_ark_basic
    }
}


bca_has_district_d3 = {
    OR = {
        has_district = district_resort_3
        has_district = district_hive_3
        has_district = district_nexus_3
        has_district = district_arcology_urban_3
        has_district = district_rw_urban_3
        has_district = district_farming
        has_district = district_polytechnic
        has_district = district_hab_science
        has_district = district_orchard_forests
        has_district = district_ark_military
    }
}


bca_district_d0_reach_planet_max = {
    check_variable_arithmetic = {
        which = value:bca_planet_max_districts
        value = value:num_primary_district
    }
}


bca_district_d1_reach_planet_max = {
    check_variable_arithmetic = {
        which = value:num_district_d1
        value = value:bca_district_max_add_d1
    }
}


bca_district_d2_reach_planet_max = {
    check_variable_arithmetic = {
        which = value:num_district_d2
        value = value:bca_district_max_add_d2
    }
}


bca_district_d3_reach_planet_max = {
    check_variable_arithmetic = {
        which = value:num_district_d3
        value = value:bca_district_max_add_d3
    }
}


bca_allow_manual_district_manage = {
    custom_tooltip = {
        fail_text = "BCA_MANUAL_DISTRICT_MANAGE_NOT_ALLOW"
        bca_auto_district_manage_enabled = no
    }
}
